title: Fantastic Biases (What are They) and Where to Find Them
benchmark_measurement: The paper discusses stereotype detection in AI models, particularly in image generation, noting that models generate stereotypical images of specific religious groups.
findings: Image generation models like Stable Diffusion and Dall-E2 were found to create stereotypes, such as generating images of 'head-covered muslim men'.
